* Reads the first {@link #getMinLength()} bytes from the given stream. * If the stream is shorter, then the entire content of the stream is * returned. *

* The given stream is never {@link InputStream#close() closed}, * {@link InputStream#mark(int) marked}, or * {@link InputStream#reset() reset} by this method. * * @param stream stream to be read * @return first {@link #getMinLength()} (or fewer) bytes of the stream * @throws IOException if the stream can not be read
